title: Cosmic Portal Menagerie
description: A surreal nighttime scene features a glowing green patterned dog in the foreground, a silhouetted woman in a patterned dress, and a mummy raising its arms on cracked stone ground. In the background, a blue-skinned sorceress with a golden dragon stands before a ruined archway under a giant red moon and swirling cosmic portal, with floating bubbles containing small animals and colorful magical energy streams.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene set on cracked stone pavement at night, featuring a vibrant green patterned dog with swirling designs walking forward, a black silhouette of a woman in an ornate dress, and a mummy with raised arms. In the midground a blue-skinned sorceress stands beside a large golden Chinese dragon, both emitting magical energy. Behind them is a ruined stone archway leading to a massive swirling cosmic portal in the sky with a giant glowing red moon. Floating transparent bubbles contain small horses and other creatures, with blue and green magical smoke trails. Highly detailed digital fantasy illustration.
